candidate.definition_en: The state of having or owning something, or an item that is owned.
candidate.explanation_ar: امتلاك الشيء أو حيازته، أو الشيء نفسه الذي يمتلكه الشخص (مقتنى أو ممتلكات).

senses.definition_en: The condition of having, owning, or controlling something.
senses.explanation_ar: حالة امتلاك الشيء أو حيازته والسيطرة عليه.
examples: The house is in his possession.
The team kept possession of the ball for most of the game.

senses.definition_en: An object or item of property that belongs to someone.
senses.explanation_ar: شيء يملكه الشخص (مقتنى أو ملكية خاصة).
examples: The manuscript is the library's most prized possession.
The house is in his possession.
The team kept possession of the ball for most of the game.
The manuscript is the library's most prized possession.
candidate.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Boss'.. الـ 'Boss' هو اللي عنده الـ 'Possession' والسيطرة على الشركة.
